title: 目標達成の後に・ドン底から上を

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The date Tamamo Cross and I agreed upon has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've stuck to our plan to build her body up before the spring Classics.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom… I can still eat a little more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And Tamamo has managed to build up a healthy appetite! As a result…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dash!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's more where that came from! Lemme show ya what these legs can do!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! Ha! Like takin' candy from a baby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her body has undergone some major developments. It's safe to say she's built up the bare minimum amount of strength an athlete needs.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Take a look, Trainer! Talk 'bout growth!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm good to start racing this year, right?! I've been seein' it in my dreams, ya know. The—
choice_data_list: Half-off sale! To the bargain bin!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya think I'd fall for that?! I know all the upcomin' sales 'round here, you're not foolin' me! I'm talkin' about the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm not the type to get caught up in the razzle-dazzle of it all. And I'm not gonna tell ya it's my dream to win that Triple Crown or anythin'. But…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: It sure would be nice to have somethin' to show people. Even the tykes back home know 'bout the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I wanna tell 'em their big sis bagged herself that same crown…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …I understand how she feels. But…
choice_data_list: I don't think we should set the bar that high.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Are you sayin'… my body's not there yet?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we need you to be stronger.
Yeah, we need you to be stronger.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Can't you do me this one favor? C'mooon. Pleeeease?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Giving Tamamo Cross the okay now would be the same as throwing her future away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's in tip-top shape when the time comes, I don't mind tackling the Triple Crown with her. I just don't want to have it as a goal until I know she's not going to get pushed around.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So how long's it gonna be? How long do I gotta wait before I can take on the big dogs?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I had to make an objective estimate based on our current progress…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What?! You sayin' I gotta spend my whole classic year waitin' around?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …All right, fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To my surprise, Tamamo Cross readily agrees to the plan, but I can see from the look in her eyes that she's beyond frustrated…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Guess that's just how it is at Tracen Academy… Talented runners from all over the country gather here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But unlike the other students, I never took any special classes. No way my folks could afford that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …It's not easy tryin' to make it big in a world so different from your own.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But don't you dare think I'm gonna let anyone tell me I can't! I come from rock bottom, so trust me—I'm used to lookin' towards the top.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And I'm not the only one strugglin' in this new world… There's plenty more like me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Some of 'em are fresh outta the boonies. But they're still dreamin' big, just like me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm not losin' to nobody! Not to the competition, not to society, not even to myself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Don't get me wrong. I'm pissed. But I'm gonna hold it all in… for now. That way, come this time next year, I can let it all out on the track!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now the ball's in your court, Trainer. Make me a plan that'll turn me into a legend!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After some thinking, I come up with a strategy. We'll enter a whole load of graded races to build up experience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The experience she'll get from them will balance out any struggles she faces going up against the pack with her weaker body.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I getcha… If I can push through the rest of the pack with sheer guts, gettin' into the top three shouldn't be that tough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: A'ight! Let's go with that then. But this plan better work!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Tamamo Cross's approval, we settle on our new strategy.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heya, Dad, what's up? Yeah, things are goin' well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, same old, same old, got my nose to the grindstone. I'm like those stubborn merchants in Naniwa. I'm not budging till I get what I came here for. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure I'm gonna have any big news for ya this year. But next year… I'll be there. I'm gonna run in that race ya love, Dad.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Anyways, how're things?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Mom? What about her? Somethin' happen? Nothin' serious? Well, if you say so…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: When she's lookin' tired, I want ya to be there for her. Just watch some TV together or something.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Speakin' of, the graded races should be on TV, yeah? Hehe. Whaddaya know? Maybe seein' me will help ya two finally relax.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: …Just make sure ya don't work too hard, 'kay? I'll do the same. All right, bye now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We need to place third or higher in four graded races. With that goal in mind, it's time to aim for the skies.
